title: Food Packaging — Concept, Types and Evaluation of Packaging Materials
shortDescription: What packaging does, material by material, and how its performance is tested.
genZNote: Packaging is the last preservation step and the first thing you judge. WVTR and OTR just tell you how well it blocks water and air.

sections.heading: Concept and Functions
bullets: Functions: containment, protection (physical, chemical, microbial), communication (labelling), convenience and marketing.
Levels: primary (touches food), secondary (groups packs), tertiary (transport, pallets).
Food contact materials must be safe and inert: limits on migration of components into food; overall migration limit commonly 10 mg/dm² or 60 mg/kg food (verify current standard).

sections.heading: Materials and Properties
sections.body: Package forms: cans, bottles, pouches, retort pouches, cartons, trays, aseptic cartons, bag-in-box, sachets.

table.caption: Packaging materials
rows: Tinplate/aluminium; barrier to light, gas; canning
PET, HDPE, LDPE, PP, PVC, PS; flexible, light
Combine barriers (e.g. Tetra Pak: paperboard + PE + aluminium foil)

sections.heading: Evaluating Packaging
bullets: Barrier: water vapour transmission rate (WVTR), oxygen transmission rate (OTR).
Mechanical: tensile strength, burst, tear, puncture, seal strength, drop and compression tests.
Chemical safety: overall and specific migration, heavy metals, residual monomers; sensory taint and odour.
Shelf-life and compatibility testing (accelerated); seam integrity of cans (double seam); leak tests.
Environmental: recyclability, extended producer responsibility under Plastic Waste Management Rules.

quickRevision.oneLineDefinition: Food packaging protects, preserves and communicates; material choice and testing ensure safety, barrier performance and compliance.
keyFacts: Tetra Pak = paperboard, polyethylene and aluminium.

commonTraps: Do not say glass is permeable to gas.
